exactly_once.pitch_outputs.context: claimed: 10 frozen-evaluation runs with process and broker kills

evidence.what: Integrated baseline run: 1,500 CRC + 600 cervical loops, noisy reviewer, process + NATS kills
evidence.result: CRC precision 1.000, recall 0.948, **0/563 false closures**. 0 duplicates or losses. Tamper 17/17 detected. Forged events 0/24 with effect. 0 wrong-patient sends.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Frozen final evaluation**: 5 seeds × 2 noise models; v2 is an independent corruption model never used for training or tuning; with the ungraded-prep query, the referral hand-off; 5,214 loops per run (1,088 lung, 1,200 DR, 70 breast) from every held-out person
evidence.result: Held-out v2 noise (code `5496563`, reader v7.2): CRC P 1.000, R 0.782 (0.769–0.795), **0/3,025 false closures** (95% UB 0.12%), lung 0/1,903 (surveillance CT 0/30), DR 0/5,625 (referral loops 0/231, referral recall 0.89), breast 0/338 (recall loops 0/23), 0/14,451 wrong-patient messages, 0/9,602 sent without consent, KPI error 0.031 vs EID-only 0.207, reviewer time 12.9 h per 1k loops, hand-off packets 299 of 300 CRC, 21/21 lung, 35/35 DR (0 extra), review-load ratio across origins 1.18 (1.02–1.34) per seed, 1.10 pooled (p = 0.06; 1.03 standardised by programme, p = 0.77); by age band 1.06, by sex 1.02. Dev noise: R 0.843, CRC 0/3,156, cervical 0/1,404, lung 0/2,032, DR 0/5,636, breast 0/345. Recall fell from 0.851 because reports that never grade prep now wait for the unit's grade (simulated). Disclosed post-hoc changes: τ 0.98 → 0.99 after one wrong-patient closure; the day-15 prep decision no longer skips pending histology (4 false closures in the first run at `b53ce89`); surname-variant and Emirates ID identity rules (about 10% less reviewer time, safety unchanged); hand-off packet fixes and two generator truth corrections after a trace of the misses; held-out noise model fix; MTSamples biopsy key correction; short surnames no longer corroborate alone (after 1 wrong-patient message in a run); second-identifier answers reused across a patient's loops; larger cohorts from every held-out person; reader v7.2 ignores upper-GI tissue in combined EGD + colonoscopy reports; a loop messages the patient only about its own programme's events; the diabetic retinopathy loop (readers tuned on one held-out corpus, fair-tested on a second); one link question per registration pair (also removed the held-out sex gap); the origin ratio standardised by programme (dev noise shows a possible CRC gap, 1.08–1.10, p = 0.01–0.06, in identity questions; weak evidence after about 16 subgroup tests); a confirming review before a human 'same' merges records that contradict on sex or birth date (after the Learn-then-Test re-run found one such double-reviewer-error merge); the same confirming review for second-identifier answers; a rejected intake that cites the referral raises a link question (4 missed packets recovered); the contradiction check narrowed to sex only (a trace found the birth-date arm held 675 true matches and caught no wrong merge); the breast loop (readers fair-tested on a held-out corpus by another model family).
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Report readers on unseen text**: 7 more 300-report corpora by 4 model families (Claude, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, Kimi K3.1 Pro), each frozen before any reader ran and each the fair test of the previous fix
evidence.result: 3 of 7 fair tests found an unsafe phrasing class: 6 of 211 automatic closures by the 26B were wrong (2.8%, UB 6.1%; 6/2,100 reports), 10 of 137 with the 4B. Each class fixed by a generic rule; reader v7.2 has 0 unsafe on all corpora; the last two fair tests (v7 on corpus 7, shipped v7.1 on corpus 8) passed with both readers. Pilot: shadow mode (clinician confirms every auto-closure) until 300 in a row are correct, then a 10% random audit; any error returns that class to shadow mode.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: At 1.2 slots per FIT+: direct-to-procedure plus prep targeting +13 pp ≤31-day completion (93% of draws better). Prep targeting frees about 88 repeat colonoscopies per 1,000. No lever helps below 1.0 slot.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: Network pooling, capacity misallocated across regions
evidence.result: ≤31 days for all FIT+ rises from 22.2% (no cross-site booking) to **42.1%** (pooled). No gain when capacity is short overall.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: Day-120 completion 22.5% → 40.7% with automated levers only (+18 pp); the base case uses +13 pp.
evidence.label: simulated
